Mia (partnerships): ok kicking off a quick triage thread for the AWS/GCP/Azure listing — we need creds, packaging, EULA, and SKU mapping checks. can folks call dibs?
Noah (product): I'm on packaging + feature matrix. will prepare a short 1-pager of supported capabilities and tiers.
Sam (legal): I'll own EULA + compliance bits. any special data residency or export controls we should call out?
Mia (partnerships): for EMEA we'll call out EU region and KMS options. for export, standard ML model export controls apply — sam i'll DM specifics.
Li (eng-ops): I'll take credentials and deployment checklist. need a list of service accounts + IAM roles for each cloud. can we standardize names?
Alex (devex): I'll do the quickstart + Terraform snippets. want to avoid publishing any secrets — will use pseudonyms in examples.
marketplace-bot: Created marketplace-task #MP-4123: "Listing prep - creds/packaging/EULA" assigned to Mia, due 3 days
Noah (product): Mia — can you confirm which product SKUs we're exposing? trial vs paid, self-serve vs enterprise?
Mia (partnerships): planned SKUs: free-tier (limited tokens), pay-as-you-go (hosted API), dedicated-reserved (dedicated capacity). will add matrix in 1-pager.
Sam (legal): for trial terms we should limit token usage and add rate limiting clause. also need to confirm whether telemetry opt-in is required for marketplace.
Alex (devex): telemetry opt-in is usually required for diagnostics on marketplace listings. will add client flag examples.
Li (eng-ops): credential list draft:
```
- aws: iam role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-marketplace-pub
- gcp: service account redwood-marketplace@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- azure: spn id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
I'll confirm exact IDs after infra creates them.
Mia (partnerships): sounds good. Noah please include SKU mapping to meter names (tokens, embeddings). Sam please review telemetry language.
Noah (product): will do. question on branding: marketplace requires a 600x300 hero image + 2 screenshots. are we re-using website assets?
Alex (devex): use website hero but crop for 600x300; I'll make a quick assets pack and a sample README.md for the listing.
Sam (legal): also need to include support & SLA language for dedicated offering. Mia do we have standard SLA text?
Mia (partnerships): yes — 99.9% monthly uptime for Dedicated, basic best-effort for hosted. i'll paste the SLA doc in this channel soon.
Li (eng-ops): one more infra note: Azure requires publisher-managed endpoint IP ranges for some customers — will flag as a known limitation in the listing.
Noah (product): thanks. timeline: can we aim to have packaging + creds + legal sign-off in 3 business days?
Mia (partnerships): 3 days is tight but doable. assigning owners:
- packaging: Noah (product)
- creds/infra checklist: Li (eng-ops)
- EULA + SLA: Sam (legal)
- quickstart + assets: Alex (devex)
Mia (partnerships): can everyone drop a short status update in this thread by EOD tomorrow?
Sam (legal): noted — will post redline suggestions by tomorrow EOD.
Alex (devex): prepping assets now, should have sample README + Terraform snippets by EOD.
Li (eng-ops): requested IAM roles from infra team, expected ETA 24hrs.
Noah (product): drafting the SKU matrix and pricing buckets, posting soon.
Mia (partnerships): awesome. if anything blocks, ping me directly or @channel for urgent issues. :rocket:
Noah (product): small question — marketplace listing needs a support contact email that can receive publisher-billing notices. Mia, what alias should we use?
Mia (partnerships): use marketplace-billing@redwood.ai for now, ops will route.
Sam (legal): also recommend adding a link to our privacy policy and SOC/ISO compliance page in the listing.
Alex (devex): added to README checklist.
marketplace-bot: Reminder set for MP-4123 review in 48 hours.
Mia (partnerships): closing note: i'll consolidate everything into the partner playbook doc and share a final checklist before we upload to each marketplace. thanks team!
